structures.name: Projected resident population, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians, identification change series, sex and age groups by states and territories and Australia, 2021 to 2031

names.en: Projected resident population, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians, identification change series, sex and age groups by states and territories and Australia, 2021 to 2031

structures.description: Contains estimates and projections of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population based on the 2021 Census of Population and Housing, by sex and five-year age groups, for the period 2006 to 2031. Population projections illustrate how the Australian Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population would change in the future as a result of certain assumptions. This dataset presents 9 scenarios, comprising combinations of different rates of fertility, paternity, mortality, interstate migration and overseas migration. Unit of measure: Projected Persons. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 3238.0
